ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Neither party will assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and IBM will not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Customer. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement, without IBM's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of Customer will give IBM any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the assignment restriction mutual and added our standard carve-out allowing us to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger or sale of substantially all assets without consent, plus confirmation that a change of control does not give IBM a termination or re-pricing right. Our fallback is a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.
input.summary: Make assignment consent mutual, add Customer affiliate/successor carve-out, bar assignment to our competitors, and confirm no IBM rights on our change of control.
